chapters: Jano' ba' ka't gu tanoolh gu Assuero jix gɨ'kora' dɨr gu India bɨɨx ka'm gu Etiopiia bhaan chamaam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ kɨɨv oidha' gɨ'.
Na mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ka't gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' ka't gu Susaan guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' jix duu vaik oidha' tas guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨx chiñia' tu duukam ua'tulhdhidha' vupui bhaan gu kavɨk gu Persia gu Media guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ chiñia' oidha' gɨ'.

Na ba' na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm namkɨm gɇ'kamtu'nda' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mui'x gu tanoolh chamaam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ dhi' ja'tkam gu tanoolh gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kɨɨv gu tanoolh naadat u'uu pai' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios vaak ja'tkam bɨx gu ja'tkam dɨr jix gɨ' bɨɨx ka'm jix ali' gu ñi'ook gu Susaan guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ka't jix toja gu vaas guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ ñakaabma' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jix toja jodai guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jix uam jodai jix toja jodai bhaan guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jodai na jix tuk.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ i'i guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix uam jodai guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix jai' suudai' u'va vaak ja'tkam jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios ka't bhaan dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga; na soo'mchulhdhak guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; na gu' ka't jix duu gu gɨ'kora' bɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu vaak; na guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan aagak maa'n.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Basti guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu u'vɨ gu vaak vaak ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero.

Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh kua' gu i'ii'ñ gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat suudai' u'va jix aa'ñdhix gu Meumaan gu Bista gu arbona gu Bigta gu Abagta gu Setar gu Karkas kɨɨv guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero.

Na guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Basti vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx kuruun guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ja'tkam chiñia' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; na gu' ka't guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Gu' gu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Basti cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' bhaam gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix jai' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Na gu' tɨtda:―¿Jax jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' mamatdagɨm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn na gu' ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu gɨ'kora' na ba' bɨɨx bɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ñi'ook na tu a'ga jix duu.

Jano' ba' mi'p ju'ñdharan gu Karsena gu Setar gu Admata gu Tarsis gu Meres gu Marsena gu Memukaan kɨɨv chiñia' gu Persia gu Media tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ dharka' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'; gio ba'.

Na gu' gu Kuee ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhaan ñi'ook na tu a'ga bɨɨx guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Basti na gu' cham ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Ba' jix aa' gu Memukaan vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' chiñia'; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhaan gu gɨ'kora' tu' uañi'ñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Basti guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bhaan bɨx chiñia' bhaan bɨx gu ja'tkam cham tu'x jai'ch guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ oidha' gɨ' gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero.

Na gu' na gu' dhi' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu u'vɨ na ba' tu jiim mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨpna' bham; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero jix aa'ñdhix guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ vupui bhaan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Basti cham suudai' u'va.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ dhi' gu Jawatan gu Persia gu Media guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨx chiñia' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jix jai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn xoi'kam gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu ñi'ook vaak ja'tkam vupui bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Persia gu Media cham ka't bhaan; na cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Basti vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero; mi' dhɨr jix maa gu gɨ'kora' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ ka't tutkɨ.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu gɨ'kora' ka't naak bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ nɨidhat bɨpna' dɨr jix gɨ' bɨɨx ka'm jix ali'.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ dhi' gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu gɨ'kora' chiñia' tu' gu gɨ'kora' jurtu'nka' tu ñi'ook gu Memukaan.

Na gu' bhañ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ oidha' gɨ' gu gɨ'kora' oidha' gɨ' jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bham bɨx gu chio'ñ jum duu gu Jawatan gu vaak; gio ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios dhi' bhaan nɨɨn gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn dhi' tu'x guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero tɨ'ñcho gu Basti ka't guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bhaan.

Jano' ba' gui'p guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ oidha' gɨ' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Susaan guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaak gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu egai guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu gɨ'kora' jix nukadham gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu vupui gu gɨ'kora' pai' gu Basti; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu vupui gu gɨ'kora' tu' jix duu.

Jano' ba' ka't gu chio'ñ gu Judiio gu Susaan guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu tɨɨgɨ' ka't gu Mardokêo gu mar gu Jair gu mar gu Simi gu mar gu Kis gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin.

Jano' ba' jix duu ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bhaan gu Jerusalem bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨɨx gu Jekôniias gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa bhaan gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia.

Na gu' ka't jix duu gu adassa gu Ester mar u'vɨ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na gu' cham ga'ra' gu taat tu' gu naan; gio ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu taat gu naan jix koko' gu Mardokêo ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mar u'vɨ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' gu Sukedioo na ja'p guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios mumua'da' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Susaan guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu egai ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gio gu Ester na ba' gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu egai jix nukadham gu u'vɨ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu vupui gu ñi'ook nɨidhidha' vupui bhaan; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix duu guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gio kɨɨv guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu vaak gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tutkɨ gu vaak gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gu Ester cham jix duu gu ja'tkam tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; na gu' gu Mardokêo ka't jix duu cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu Mardokêo guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios vupui bhaan naadat gu vaak gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm maachim gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Ester guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Na gu' na ja'p guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat dhi' tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm masaa'n jurtu'nka' ñi'ook na tu a'ga guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu u'vɨ na gu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam dhi' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn masaa'n bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn masaa'n bɨɨx tu'x guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu u'vɨ.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' bɨx chɨtda guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu vaak gu u'vɨ bɨɨx ka'm gu vaak gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu xumai gu xibh guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu vaak gookim gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Saasgas guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu gɨ'kora' jix nukadham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam ka't mɨmɨim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tɨɨgɨ'.

Ba' jix aa' tu jiim ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Ester mar u'vɨ gu Abiail guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Mardokêo ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mar u'vɨ na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu gɨ'kora' matgɨm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu egai guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu gɨ'kora' jix nukadham gu u'vɨ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Ester nɨidhidha' bɨx tu jiim.

Jano' ba' ka't gu Ester guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero gu vaak vaak ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Tebet oidha' tas kɨɨv guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Ester bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook nɨidhidha' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios vupui bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' jix dhaas kuruun vaak ja'tkam mo'o tu' jix duu guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim pai' gu Basti.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨx chiñia' tu duukam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Ester; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ oidha' gɨ' tu' jix duu jix maa guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ vaak ja'tkam.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gookim tu jiim gu Mardokêo ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam ki'ñgob gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu Ester bhaan ga'ra' jix duu gu Mardokêo cham ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu ja'tkam tu' gu ja'tkam; na pai' dhuuk na gu' gu Ester guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam chɨtda gu Mardokêo na ja'p na pai' dhuuk bɨɨx guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh kua' gu Mardokêo daakat ki'ñgob gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Bigtaan gu Teres gook guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ki'ñgob guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero.

Jano' ba' jix duu jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ka't bakia' dhuu; na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam ba'k jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; mi' dhɨr ua'na guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn u'uan tu'x guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' tu'x gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Amaan gu mar gu Amadata gu Agageo guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix dhaas guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhaan bɨx chiñia' mi'p bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' tu duukam gu gɨ'kora' mi'p ki'ñgob gui'p gu Mardokêo; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bhaan gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu Amaan gu Mardokêo tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ vupui bhaan; gio ba' jix bhuup guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Gu' gu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu novɨ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Mardokêo; na tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu ja'tkam gu Mardokêo; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Amaan cham tu' duu bɨx gu Judiios ka't oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Assuero gu ja'tkam gu Mardokêo.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ maa'n guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Nisaan oidha' tas guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero ka't guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Pur dhi' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam vupui bhaan gu Amaan gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' jix buus guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Adar.

Ba' jix aa' gu Amaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero; gio ba' cham tu'x jai'ch gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ oidha' gɨ' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na tu a'ga guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨx gu ja'tkam cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' cham jupaabkamu'n guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jix duu.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' tu' jix duu mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' cha'tmam jix toja jodai gu noobh guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga na ba' ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu novɨ jix maa gu Amaan gu mar gu Amadata gu Agageo bhaamki'ñdha' gu Judiios.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' jix toja jodai guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ka't na ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa xoi'kam tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu mɨmɨim guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ maa'n guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn ka't ua'nak jurtu'nka' bɨx jix aa'ñdhix gu Amaan chiñia' gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa mi'p bhaan oidha' gɨ' chiñia' gu ja'tkam oidha' gɨ' bhaan gu'p gu ja'tkam bhaan nɨɨn; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero ka't ua'nak guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ oidha' gɨ' gu gɨ'kora' na ba' cham tu' duu kooda' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨx gu Judiios dɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn a'aalh gu u'vɨ gu tanoolh guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Adar na ba' tu jiim guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam ua'nak koi guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook oidha' gɨ' ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios na ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' moor guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu gɨ'kora' jir bɨx bhai' ka't jix maa gu Susaan guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Amaan mi'p guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ i'i kiicham gu Susaan ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Mardokêo bɨx ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jajannulhi'ñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios maatai ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨjɨɨ'ñ kiicham jiiñkɨk bɨɨx jix gɨ' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va bɨɨx ka'm vupui bhaan ki'ñgob gu gɨ'kora'; na gu' cham ka't guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ ki'ñgob gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx tɨi'chu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' oidha' gɨ' pai' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ko'kmarak gu Judiios jix gɨ' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam suanda' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios maatai ka't guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa mui'x.

Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Ester guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhañ jajannulhi'ñ na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Mardokêo tu jiim guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bhaan; gu' cham guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Ester jup tɨɨt gu Atak maa'n guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu gɨ'kora' ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam vupui bhaan jix aa'ñdhix gu Mardokêo bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam maachim guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ka't mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' jix buus gu Atak gu Mardokêo ɨrban kiicham ka't vupui bhaan ki'ñgob gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu Mardokêo jix duu bɨx ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix maa guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jix toja jodai gu Amaan ka't tu ñi'ook na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Judiios na ba' cham tu' duu.

Jano' ba' jix maa gio guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu'p guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jix maa gu Susaan na ba' bhaai'n guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Ester guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jum duu gu gɨ'kora' jix duu guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ vupui bhaan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Atak guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Ester gu ñi'ook gu Mardokêo.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Ester gu Atak jix aa'ñdhix guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Mardokêo.

Jano' ba' bɨx tu duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam oidha' gɨ' gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ ba'k gu gɨ'kora' naadat guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tɨɨgim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ ñi'ook na tu a'ga tu' koi; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ mii' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix uam jodai ii'mdagaram; mi' dhɨr tu' cham guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ mɨmɨim na ba' baakɨi gu gɨ'kora' dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gui'p gu Mardokêo gu ñi'ook gu Ester.

Ba' jix aa' gu Ester tu ñi'ook gu Mardokêo.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios namki'ñdha' bhaan gu oidha' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu gɨ' suudai'.

Jano' ba' bɨx tu duukam gu kavɨk guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jix duu guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Mardokêo bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ cham ua'nak u'uan guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu gɨ'kora' gu Media gu Persia.

Na gu' na gu' gu Mardokêo gu Judiio ka't gook mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero jix gɨ' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Judiios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn xoi'kam gu ja'tkam a'gi'ñchu' bhai'x i'ii'ñ na ba' bɨx gu kai'.
